items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: We went down to Miami and we had to play opposite Wayne Cochran and the CC Riders that blew us out of the water.

ctx.x: Did you have an option of another line of work? Because last night I heard you saying that you know I just worked weekends, it never occurred to me that I might make a living. I might be extrapolating on what you said, but was there another option for you?

No. I had no other options. No. I mean all I did was play the guitar. I was a high school dropout, I never went to music college, I don’t have a degree in music or anything like that. I left school in the middle of the eleventh grade, went on the road with one of my bands, a ten-piece band. We went down to Miami and we had to play opposite Wayne Cochran and the CC Riders that blew us out of the water. I mean we were a good band but that band was killing. I remember going back and going, “I want to do this, I want…
How – why? Why did people know your name to have you do that?
